description: Hand-labeled synthetic gold set for the zero-model, zero-network local commitment extractor (packages/advisers/lib/mail-extract.js). 90 dev + 30 held-out fixtures; held-out is release-gate only.
heldoutPolicy: The 30 held-out fixtures and their labels are frozen by corpusSha256. Do not tune the extractor against held-out results; L0 (PR) runs only --split dev. The held-out split runs only in the release gate.
dueDateSemantics: dueAt is a calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) in Asia/Shanghai. The local extractor resolves relative dates to 18:00 Asia/Shanghai by default, so this eval compares only the local calendar date, never the instant.
matching: A predicted candidate matches a labeled commitment when its action matches after normalization (verb/object inclusion, ignoring whitespace, case and a leading verb) and both commitments are in the same message.
